company.name: ExpressVPN
company.shortDescription: A private internet connection (VPN), with optional password keeper and identity protection.
company.planHelp: Sign in at expressvpn.com, then open 'My Account' or 'Subscription'. It shows which plan you are on, what you pay and the date it renews.

sources.title: What subscriptions are available with ExpressVPN?
ExpressVPN Introduces Tiered Pricing: Basic, Advanced, and Pro

features.label: Devices protected at the same time
features.question: How many devices (phones, computers, and tablets) do you want to protect?
features.help: Count everything you would want protected at once, including your family's phones.

features.label: Password keeper
features.question: Would you like a safe place to store your passwords so you do not have to remember them?
features.help: ExpressVPN calls this "Keys". The cheapest plan does not include it.

features.label: Identity protection and insurance
features.question: Do you want someone watching for your personal details being sold online, plus insurance if your identity is stolen?
features.help: Available to customers in the United States only.

features.label: Blocking ads and dangerous websites

levelLabels.lite: Basic blocking of ads and harmful sites
levelLabels.advanced: Stronger blocking of ads, trackers and harmful sites

features.question: How much blocking of ads and dangerous websites do you want?

features.label: Your own private internet address
features.question: Do you need your own private internet address that nobody else shares?
features.help: Most people do not need this. It can help if your bank's website keeps blocking you. On cheaper plans it can be bought separately.

plans.name: Basic
plans.bestFor: Someone who only wants a fast, private internet connection.
plans.notes: The $99.95 a year figure is ExpressVPN's own stated ongoing price ('Then autorenews at $99.95 annually'). The MONTH-BY-MONTH price could not be verified: ExpressVPN's public pricing and order pages only display the 2-year introductory offer, so monthly is set to null. PROMOTIONAL ONLY: $83.72 for the first 28 months (advertised as $2.99/month), then $99.95/year. A dedicated IP address can be added for an extra fee.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.bestFor: Most people: private internet plus a password keeper and a watch on your personal details.
plans.notes: $119.95 a year is ExpressVPN's stated ongoing price. Month-by-month price not published on the public pages, so set to null. PROMOTIONAL ONLY: $111.72 for the first 28 months (advertised as $3.99/month). Identity Defender here includes dark web monitoring, Social Security number monitoring, data removal, credit alerts and up to $3,000,000 identity theft insurance (US customers only). Also includes 3 days of eSIM travel data on 12-month and 2-year plans.

plans.name: Express Pro
plans.bestFor: Someone who wants everything, including their own private internet address and the largest identity theft insurance.
plans.notes: $199.95 a year is ExpressVPN's stated ongoing price. Month-by-month price not published on the public pages, so set to null. PROMOTIONAL ONLY: $167.72 for the first 28 months (advertised as $5.99/month). Adds a dedicated IP address at no extra cost, data removal, monthly credit reports, home title, auto title and court record monitoring, and up to $5,000,000 identity theft insurance (US customers only), plus 5 days of eSIM travel data on 12-month and 2-year plans.

faq.q: Why can't I see a simple monthly price?
faq.a: ExpressVPN's public pricing page only advertises its 2-year introductory offer. It does sell 1-month and 12-month subscriptions, but the prices for those are only shown once you start the sign-up, so they are not recorded here.

faq.q: What happens when my introductory offer ends?
faq.a: The subscription renews automatically at the standard yearly price: $99.95 for Basic, $119.95 for Advanced and $199.95 for Pro. That is usually much more than you paid for the first term.

faq.q: What is the difference between the three plans?
faq.a: They all give the same private internet connection. Advanced adds a password keeper and identity monitoring; Pro adds your own private internet address, data removal and the largest insurance cover.

faq.q: Can I try it and get my money back?
faq.a: ExpressVPN advertises a 30-day money-back guarantee for new customers on all three plans.

notes: ExpressVPN moved to three tiers (Basic, Advanced, Express Pro) in 2025. Verified from official pages on 2026-09-21. The only prices ExpressVPN publishes openly are the 2-year introductory offers and the annual renewal prices; 1-month and 12-month prices are not shown publicly, which is why every plan is marked 'uncertain'. Identity Defender features are limited to customers in the United States.
